const s1 = sketch('top'); s1.polygon([[0,0],[60,0],[60,40],[0,40]]); const plate = extrude(s1, 10); const p1 = sketch('top', 10); p1.circle(6, { at: [10, 10] }); const pk = pocket(p1, plate, 4); mirror(pk, 'left-right', { at: 10.005 });
note: mirror plane 0.005 from the pocket centre: copy lands 0.01 away
shipped: mirror() of a pocket cuts a copy of the pocket at each place, and copy 1 and copy 2 of the cut overlap each other, so brep-rs cannot yet join overlapping cuts into the same single part FreeCAD gives. Cut the extra pockets yourself, one sketch and pocket(...) each.
sentence: mirror(): the pocket and its reflection overlap, which mirror() cannot cut yet -- cut the second pocket yourself, one sketch and pocket(...).
